youtube.title: The 18-year-old who destroyed Lord Byron in a ghost story contest 🧟 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Frankenstein was born because Lord Byron got bored on a rainy holiday. ⚡🧟

Byron started a ghost story contest, quit after two pages... and Mary Shelley invented science fiction.

Who really won the Villa Diodati contest? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on June 1816 at Lake Geneva: during the "year without a summer" Byron challenged his guests to write ghost stories. His own fragment was abandoned (Polidori turned it into The Vampyre, first published under Byron's name), while 18-year-old Mary Shelley began Frankenstein.

#frankenstein #maryshelley #lordbyron #literature #gothichorror #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
